name: Nikkou
source:
Level/Level Cap: 51/71
Skill Level(s): Sword Combat LV2

[spoiler]A legendary sword of incredible power that is one of only three weapons in existence capable of piercing through the invincibility field of a demon. Unlike [url=/c55383]Chaos[/url], she is actually capable of transforming into a human form on command.

She is actually a former member of the Legendary Five, the greatest adventuring party in history, who was turned into a sword after she requested for the god Planner to give her the power to pierce the invincibility field.

She is currently in the possession of [url=/c53096]Ogawa Kentarou[/url], who had been using her to fight off the demons of the Kayblis faction. After Kentarou becomes incapacitated, however, she offers herself to be used by Rance temporarily.[/spoiler]
